name: magic_lst1
label: MAGIC-I + MAGIC-II + LST-1 (ORM)
sources: CTAO-North array element positions (CTAN_ArrayElements_Positions.ecsv, CTAO gitlab, via ctapipe_io_zfits), reference 28.762158 N, -17.892009 E, 2147 m: LSTN-01 at 28.761526 N, -17.891497 E, 2185 m

MAGIC-I/II: ctapipe_io_magic (cta-observatory) 'MAGIC telescope positions wrt the center of CTA simulations' (-27.24, -146.66, 50.00) and (-96.44, -96.77, 51.00) m in the CORSIKA frame (x north, y west, z up), i.e. 85.3 m apart (published 85-86 m)
Raiola et al. 2025, PoS ICRC2025 957 / Abe et al. 2023 (arXiv:2310.01954): MAGIC-I to MAGIC-II 85-86 m, LST-1 '~100 m' from the MAGIC telescopes
notes: Surveyed geometry: MAGIC-I-II 85.3 m, LST-1-MAGIC-I 105.8 m, LST-1-MAGIC-II 53.6 m. The papers describe the two LST-1 baselines as 'approximately 100 m'; the surveyed positions make one of them 54 m. The MAGIC positions are the collaboration's software constants, not a survey document.
